name: How long does it typically take to install new bathroom fixtures?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to install new bathroom fixtures?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing standard bathroom fixtures like a faucet, showerhead, or toilet usually takes two to four hours when connecting to existing supply and drain lines. Replacing a full suite of fixtures—including a new vanity, tub, and shower trim—typically spans one to two days. Timelines expand if your project requires opening walls to relocate pipes, repairing water-damaged subflooring, or installing custom tile surrounds around the new hardware. Working with a general contractor who manages both carpentry and plumbing trade partners prevents delays between rough-in work and finish trim.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacing standard fixtures in existing locations takes 2 to 4 hours. Replacing a full set with a vanity or tub usually takes 1 to 2 days, longer if plumbing must move.
